title: Arizona District 4

bio.title: Zuhdi Jasser
bio.description: American doctor, Muslim activist, and commentator (born 1967)
bio.bio: Mohamed Zuhdi Jasser is an American religious and political commentator and a medical doctor specializing in internal medicine and nuclear cardiology in Phoenix, Arizona.

bio.title: Greg Stanton
bio.bio: Gregory John Stanton is an American lawyer and politician who is the U.S. representative from Arizona's 4th congressional district, serving since 2019. A Democrat, he was previously mayor of Phoenix from 2012 to 2018, and was on the Phoenix City Council from 2000 until 2009.

summary: There are no qualifying public polls yet, so the forecast leans on fundamentals; partisan lean, the national environment and incumbency point to Greg Stanton +18.5.
